parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of devices to display on each page in the response.
